notes: Playing straight through the Albums tab walked the albums in a different order from the cards on screen: the queue sorted them by year and then by name, while the cards sit in the order you dragged them into.
An album you moved to the top of your list could therefore be heard last, and one whose name sorts late came before albums you had ranked above it.
The Albums play queue now reads the very same order the cards are rendered from - the album order you built, then the albums left over in the library’s own order.
Nothing about an album’s own songs changed: tapping a song inside a card still plays that album from top to bottom, in the order the card shows it, exactly as before.
Your albums, their order, the songs inside them and your playlists are untouched by this release - it only changes the order the albums themselves are played in.
Your songs, lyrics, player screen and home-screen widget are untouched by this release.
